rows.new: Арманың үлкен болсын. Күйресе де, сынықтары үлкен болады.
rows.reason: First draft Үлкен арман арманда repeated the cognate (арман/арманда, ‘dream a dream’), which reads as a translation; replaced with the optative Арманың үлкен болсын.
rows.metric: Home-screen quotation translation

rows.old: Чоң кыялдан. Ал талкаланса да, сыныктары чоң болот.
rows.new: Кыялың чоң болсун. Талкаланса да, сыныктары чоң болот.
rows.reason: First draft Чоң кыялдан (‘dream big’ as a bare imperative) is unidiomatic; replaced with the optative Кыялың чоң болсун.
rows.metric: Home-screen quotation translation

rows.old: Том мөрөөд. Хэдий хагарсан ч хэлтэрхий нь том хэвээр байна.
rows.new: Том мөрөөд. Хагарсан ч хэлтэрхий нь том байна.
rows.reason: First draft Хэдий хагарсан ч … том хэвээр байна was wordy (‘however much it broke, still remains big’); shortened to Хагарсан ч хэлтэрхий нь том байна.
rows.metric: Home-screen quotation translation

rows.old: Cuando aparece una piedra en el camino, el débil la llama tropiezo y el fuerte la llama peldaño.
rows.new: Cuando aparece una piedra en el camino, el débil la llama obstáculo y el fuerte la llama escalón.
rows.reason: First draft used tropiezo / peldaño; tropiezo as a bare noun for the stone is stilted. Replaced with obstáculo / escalón.
rows.metric: Home-screen quotation translation

rows.old: Quando uma pedra surge no caminho, o fraco a chama de tropeço e o forte a chama de degrau.
rows.new: Quando uma pedra surge no caminho, o fraco a chama de obstáculo e o forte a chama de degrau.
rows.reason: First draft tropeço / degrau; tropeço reads as ‘a stumble’, not the stone. Replaced with obstáculo.
rows.metric: Home-screen quotation translation

rows.old: Ha kő kerül az útba, a gyenge botlásnak nevezi, az erős lépcsőfoknak.
rows.new: Ha kő kerül az útba, a gyenge akadálynak nevezi, az erős lépcsőfoknak.
rows.reason: First draft botlásnak (‘a stumble’) named the act, not the stone; replaced with akadálynak.
rows.metric: Home-screen quotation translation

rows.old: Saat batu menghadang di jalan, orang lemah menyebutnya sandungan, orang kuat menyebutnya pijakan.
rows.new: Saat batu menghadang di jalan, orang lemah menyebutnya batu sandungan, orang kuat menyebutnya batu pijakan.
rows.reason: First draft sandungan / pijakan dropped batu; the idioms are batu sandungan and batu pijakan.
rows.metric: Home-screen quotation translation

rows.old: Quando una pietra si trova sul cammino, il debole la chiama inciampo e il forte la chiama gradino.
rows.new: Quando una pietra si trova sul cammino, il debole la chiama un ostacolo e il forte un gradino.
rows.reason: First draft inciampo / gradino; inciampo alone is ‘a trip’. Replaced with un ostacolo.
